name: Pre-integrated Volume Rendering at Clip Boundaries
definition: A technique to handle rendering artifacts at clip boundaries when using pre-integrated volume rendering and low sampling rates by computing the contribution of the ray segment between the clipping surface and the first slice of the clipped volume.
summary: Pre-integrated Volume Rendering at Clip Boundaries corrects artifacts at clip planes by computing optical contributions between the clipping surface and the first volume slice, avoiding complex boundary layer models.
